views.title: Ecosystem
views.subtitle: Which packages cooperate. Lines are undirected mutual benefit, not dependencies.

edges.label:
Requests + experience
Inference + contracts
details: Reploid contributes real model workloads, demand, diverse environments and measured failures.
Doppler contributes executable intelligence, public inference interfaces and valid model partitions.
Independent evaluation and release authority remain separate.

edges.label:
Model workloads
Efficient GPU execution
details: Doppler contributes demanding applications, reproducible WGSL workloads and developer access.
Doe contributes a potentially faster, leaner and more diagnosable GPU implementation.
Gains must be measured using unchanged application semantics; mutual benefit does not make Doe a required provider.

notes.label: A — B — C
notes.text: Shared neighbor does not imply an A–C relationship. Each package remains independently useful.

entities.label: Reploid
entities.responsibility: Coordinate and improve the intelligence network
owns: Poolday: peer connectivity and authorized WebRTC exchange
Independent evaluation, reversible adoption and strategy evolution
excludes: Model mathematics and learned expert selection
Automatic disclosure or contribution merely from joining
entities.independence: An agent may operate independently; the collaborating network remains the product.

entities.label: Doppler
owns: Rig: source models, ModelIR, TargetPlans and qualification
Capsules: identified executable programs, weights and dependencies
Run: loading, model operations, adapters and valid partitions
Sampling, tensor contracts and generation-state semantics
entities.independence: Usable without Reploid and with supported WebGPU providers other than Doe.

entities.label: Doe
entities.responsibility: Compile WGSL and implement GPU execution
owns: WGSL compilation and general shader optimization
Native Metal, Vulkan and D3D12 execution paths
GPU resource ownership, synchronization and failure reporting
General diagnostics useful to unrelated applications
excludes: Model selection, tokenization or quantization policy
Automatic replacement of a browser’s GPU implementation
entities.independence: Useful to applications unrelated to Doppler; integration requires an explicit provider boundary.
